items.title: Make context-manager the sole prompt-context authority
items.body: Integrate the existing Semantika-backed knowledge stores through context-manager. Route workspace/personal knowledge context through contextManager.resolve(). Delete ai-cli-owned prompt packing/formatting that becomes redundant. Once personal/workspace context no longer depends on Laya scope selection, remove scope_isolation from System-1 too. Reads should use bounded relevance, not a brittle read-scope classifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Use local sibling @dharmax/context-manager and SemantikaContextSource or minimal relation-to-ContextBlock projection; route knowledge through contextManager.resolve.
Deterministic regression proves workspace and personal stores remain structurally isolated.
Deterministic regressions prove maxTokens and maxItems bounds are enforced by context-manager.
Deterministic regression proves ordinary non-context questions perform no unnecessary retrieval.
Existing knowledge/context tests pass; no duplicate vector/tag/search or retrieval/packing paths remain.
Remove obsolete ai-cli packing/formatting and scope_isolation once independent of Laya; preserve baseline safety and same-run recovery.

items.title: Collapse duplicate skill discovery into skill-manager ownership
items.body: ResourceRegistry indexes executable tools/capabilities only; skill-manager owns skill lifecycle, discovery, activation. No duplicate semantic skill indexing/classification; compose results without another umbrella registry/planner/resource graph. Skill affinity and activation regressions pass. Initial selection and same-run recovery both resolve matched skill requires.capabilities to real ToolDefinition. Keep small initial Actor tool surface, bounded run-local recovery and no global Actor tool growth.
